newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices regain initiative.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices regain initiative.

text.p: Indian cotton prices bounced back from lower levels on Wednesday, dealers said.
Fresh mill buying as well as expectation that the government may allow more exports, sent prices up.
In the spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by 10/15 rupees to 785/820 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while F-414 lifted by 30 rupees to 1,830/1,855 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium staple) rose by 300 rupees to 11,400/11,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).

Arrivals in the Punjab region remained low at 17,000/18,000 bales (170 kg each). Limited availability of good quality cotton also kept market sentiments firm at the close of the session. -Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
